run_isdf_training: run the iSDF training loop with a config file via the CLI entry point
run_isdf_headless: run the iSDF training loop in headless mode with no visualisations enabled
run_isdf_incremental: run the iSDF training loop with incremental SLAM enabled for keyframe selection
run_isdf_with_saving: run the iSDF training loop and save checkpoints, slices, and meshes to disk
run_isdf_with_evaluation: run the iSDF training loop with SDF and mesh evaluation against ground truth
